test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2021: Official Paper (Held On : 25 May 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: If 15 kg of sugar cost ₹600, what is the cost of 25 kg of sugar?
solution:
**Given:**

15 kg of sugar cost ₹600

**Formula used:**

Rate of an item = frac{{amount of some quantity}}{ {quantity}}

**Calculation:**

Cost of 1kg sugar (in Rs.)= (600)/(15)= 40

**∴ The cost of 25 kg of sugar is 40 × 25 = Rs. 1000.**
